items.headline: Danaher completes acquisition of Masimo Corporation, making it a wholly owned subsidiary in the Diagnostics segment
Danaher confirms no material Masimo contribution to Q2 2026 and plans to update full-year 2026 guidance with Q2 earnings release
Masimo, a Danaher company, receives FDA 510(k) clearance for AI-enabled opioid-induced respiratory depression detection on Radius VSM wearable monitor
